descripcion.en: The second conditional talks about an unreal present or future: if I had more time, I would travel more. At B1 the goal is to build the form correctly and use it in real, everyday hypotheticals about wishes and imagined situations.
descripcion.de: Der second conditional beschreibt eine irreale Situation in der Gegenwart oder Zukunft: if I had more time, I would travel more. Auf B1-Niveau geht es darum, die Form korrekt zu bilden und sie für echte Alltagshypothesen über Wünsche und vorgestellte Situationen zu verwenden.
descripcion.es: El second conditional habla de una situación irreal en el presente o el futuro: if I had more time, I would travel more. En B1, el objetivo es formar correctamente la estructura y usarla en hipótesis cotidianas sobre deseos y situaciones imaginadas.
descripcion.fr: Le second conditional parle d'une situation irréelle dans le présent ou le futur : if I had more time, I would travel more. Au niveau B1, l'objectif est de construire correctement la forme et de l'utiliser dans des hypothèses quotidiennes sur des souhaits et des situations imaginées.
descripcion.it: Il second conditional parla di una situazione irreale nel presente o nel futuro: if I had more time, I would travel more. Al livello B1, l'obiettivo è costruire correttamente la forma e usarla in ipotesi quotidiane su desideri e situazioni immaginate.
descripcion.pt: O second conditional fala de uma situação irreal no presente ou no futuro: if I had more time, I would travel more. No nível B1, o objetivo é formar corretamente a estrutura e usá-la em hipóteses do dia a dia sobre desejos e situações imaginadas.

filas.en: I could travel more if I had time.
filas.de: Ich könnte mehr reisen, wenn ich Zeit hätte.
filas.es: Podría viajar más si tuviera tiempo.
filas.fr: Je pourrais voyager davantage si j'avais le temps.
filas.it: Potrei viaggiare di più se avessi tempo.
filas.pt: Eu poderia viajar mais se tivesse tempo.

texto.en: If I had more time, I would travel a lot more.
texto.de: Wenn ich mehr Zeit hätte, würde ich viel mehr reisen.
texto.es: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría mucho más.
texto.fr: Si j'avais plus de temps, je voyagerais beaucoup plus.
texto.it: Se avessi più tempo, viaggerei molto di più.
texto.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo, viajaria muito mais.

texto.en: If she knew about it, she would say something.
texto.de: Wenn sie davon wüsste, würde sie etwas sagen.
texto.es: Si ella lo supiera, diría algo.
texto.fr: Si elle le savait, elle dirait quelque chose.
texto.pt: Se ela soubesse, diria alguma coisa.

texto.en: What would you do if you won the lottery?
texto.de: Was würdest du tun, wenn du im Lotto gewinnen würdest?
texto.fr: Que ferais-tu si tu gagnais à la loterie ?
texto.it: Che cosa faresti se vincessi alla lotteria?
texto.pt: O que você faria se ganhasse na loteria?

notas.en: Were is used instead of was with I/he/she/it in careful English: if I were you.
notas.de: In sorgfältigem Englisch verwendet man bei I/he/she/it were statt was: if I were you.
notas.es: En inglés cuidado se usa were en lugar de was con I/he/she/it: if I were you.
notas.fr: Dans un anglais soigné, on utilise were au lieu de was avec I/he/she/it : if I were you.
notas.it: Nell'inglese più formale si usa were invece di was con I/he/she/it: if I were you.
notas.pt: Em um inglês mais cuidadoso, usa-se were em vez de was com I/he/she/it: if I were you.

notas.en: Would never appears inside the if-clause.
notas.es: Would nunca aparece en la oración con if.
notas.fr: Would ne s'emploie jamais dans la proposition en if.
notas.it: Would non compare mai nella proposizione con if.
notas.pt: Would nunca aparece na oração com if.

notas.en: Use the second conditional for something unreal or unlikely, not a real future possibility.
notas.de: Verwende den second conditional für etwas Irreales oder Unwahrscheinliches, nicht für eine reale Möglichkeit in der Zukunft.
notas.es: Usa el second conditional para algo irreal o poco probable, no para una posibilidad futura real.
notas.fr: Utilise le second conditional pour quelque chose d'irréel ou de peu probable, pas pour une possibilité future réelle.
notas.it: Usa il second conditional per qualcosa di irreale o improbabile, non per una possibilità futura reale.
notas.pt: Use o second conditional para algo irreal ou improvável, não para uma possibilidade futura real.

contraste.es: Spanish uses si + imperfecto de subjuntivo and the simple conditional (si tuviera tiempo, viajaría), with the same logic as English. The typical error is putting would in the if-clause as well, especially for speakers of varieties that use the conditional after si (si tendría).
contraste.de: German has the same logic (Wenn ich Zeit hätte, würde ich reisen), but colloquial German also allows würde after wenn. This leads to if I would have time, the most frequent error with the second conditional.
contraste.it: Italian has the same logic (se avessi tempo, viaggerei) and no conditional after se, so the structure transfers well. New for Italian speakers is the form if I were for all persons, which has no Italian equivalent.
contraste.fr: French si + imparfait (si j'avais le temps, je voyagerais) corresponds exactly to if + past simple, and French does not allow the conditional after si. The second conditional is therefore one of the easiest structures for French speakers.
contraste.pt: Portuguese has the same logic (se tivesse tempo, viajaria). In colloquial European Portuguese the imperfeito often replaces the conditional (viajava), which can lead to I travelled more instead of I would travel more.

errores.en: Using would in the if-clause: if I would have time.
errores.de: Would im if-Satz verwenden: if I would have time.
errores.es: Usar would en la oración con if: if I would have time.
errores.fr: Utiliser would dans la proposition en if : if I would have time.
errores.it: Usare would nella proposizione con if: if I would have time.
errores.pt: Usar would na oração com if: if I would have time.

errores.en: Using was instead of were in formal writing.
errores.de: In formellen Texten was statt were verwenden.
errores.es: Usar was en lugar de were en escritura formal.
errores.fr: Utiliser was au lieu de were dans un registre soigné.
errores.it: Usare was invece di were nello scritto formale.
errores.pt: Usar was em vez de were na escrita formal.

errores.en: Confusing this with the first conditional for a real possibility.
errores.de: Das mit dem first conditional für eine reale Möglichkeit verwechseln.
errores.es: Confundirlo con el first conditional para una posibilidad real.
errores.fr: Le confondre avec le first conditional pour une possibilité réelle.
errores.it: Confonderlo con il first conditional per una possibilità reale.
errores.pt: Confundir isso com o first conditional para uma possibilidade real.

autochequeo.en: Is the if-clause in the past simple, with no would?
autochequeo.de: Steht der if-Satz im past simple und ohne would?
autochequeo.es: ¿La oración con if está en past simple y sin would?
autochequeo.fr: La proposition en if est-elle au past simple, sans would ?
autochequeo.it: La proposizione con if è al past simple, senza would?
autochequeo.pt: A oração com if está no past simple, sem would?

autochequeo.en: Is were used instead of was in careful writing?
autochequeo.de: Wird in sorgfältigem Englisch were statt was verwendet?
autochequeo.es: ¿Se usa were en lugar de was en un registro cuidado?
autochequeo.fr: Were est-il utilisé à la place de was dans un registre soigné ?
autochequeo.it: Nello scritto curato si usa were invece di was?
autochequeo.pt: Em um inglês mais cuidadoso, usa-se were em vez de was?

autochequeo.en: Is the situation genuinely unreal, not a real future possibility?
autochequeo.de: Ist die Situation wirklich irreal und keine reale Möglichkeit in der Zukunft?
autochequeo.es: ¿La situación es realmente irreal y no una posibilidad futura real?
autochequeo.fr: La situation est-elle réellement irréelle et non une possibilité future réelle ?
autochequeo.it: La situazione è davvero irreale e non una possibilità futura reale?
autochequeo.pt: A situação é realmente irreal, e não uma possibilidade futura real?

autochequeo.en: Have I used at least two full second-conditional sentences?
autochequeo.de: Habe ich mindestens zwei vollständige Sätze im second conditional verwendet?
autochequeo.es: ¿He usado al menos dos oraciones completas en second conditional?
autochequeo.fr: Ai-je utilisé au moins deux phrases complètes au second conditional ?
autochequeo.it: Ho usato almeno due frasi complete al second conditional?
autochequeo.pt: Usei pelo menos duas frases completas no second conditional?

promptCorreccion.en: Focus only on the second conditional. Check for would inside the if-clause, check were versus was, and check whether the situation is genuinely unreal. Do not rewrite the text.
promptCorreccion.de: Konzentriere dich nur auf den second conditional. Prüfe, ob would im if-Satz vorkommt, ob were und was richtig verwendet werden und ob die Situation tatsächlich irreal ist. Schreibe den Text nicht um.
promptCorreccion.es: Concéntrate únicamente en el second conditional. Comprueba si aparece would en la oración con if, el uso de were frente a was y si la situación es realmente irreal. No reescribas el texto.
promptCorreccion.fr: Concentre-toi uniquement sur le second conditional. Vérifie s'il y a would dans la proposition en if, l'emploi de were par rapport à was et si la situation est réellement irréelle. Ne réécris pas le texte.
promptCorreccion.it: Concentrati solo sul second conditional. Controlla se compare would nella proposizione con if, l'uso di were rispetto a was e se la situazione è davvero irreale. Non riscrivere il testo.
promptCorreccion.pt: Concentre-se apenas no second conditional. Verifique se há would na oração com if, o uso de were em comparação com was e se a situação é realmente irreal. Não reescreva o texto.
